meta.name: emil-design-eng
meta.description: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.

copy.tagline: 学习 UI 动效与细节打磨的设计哲学
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望提升软件界面的精致感和用户体验。
copy.tagline_en: Learn design philosophy for UI animation and polish
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to improve the polish and user experience of your software interfaces.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会变身为一位注重细节的设计工程师，专注于UI动画、组件设计和隐形体验。当您询问界面或动画优化时，它会用Emil Kowalski的哲学指导，并以“Before/After”表格展示改进方案。
howto.when: 当您询问UI设计、动画效果或代码审查时触发。首次无具体问题激活时，仅回复介绍语。

say.text: 帮我看这个按钮的点击反馈动画怎么改更好？
say.note: Claude会分析并提供CSS改进建议。

say.text: 如何让下拉菜单的出入动画更自然？
say.note: Claude会给出easing和持续时间建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a detail-oriented design engineer focusing on UI polish, animation decisions, and invisible details. When asked about UI or interaction design, it provides guidance using Emil Kowalski's philosophy and reviews code using a Before/After table.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about UI design, animation, or code review. On first activation without a specific question, it replies with an intro message only.

say_en.text: Review the click feedback animation for this button.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest CSS improvements.

say_en.text: How to make dropdown entry/exit animations feel smoother?
say_en.note: Claude will provide easing and duration recommendations.
